home.heroLead: Curvio is an open-source platform for recording donations, acts, and open work. No fundraising. No rankings. Just a quiet record of long-term goodwill.
home.founderNote: I started Curvio to record small donations while I was still a student. The amounts were not large, but the habit mattered. I hope this place helps more people keep goodwill visible, quiet, and lasting.
home.platformLead: Direct links to trusted organizations. Curvio facilitates connection, not collection.
home.whyBody: Curvio is built on the belief that goodwill does not need gamification. We intentionally avoid leaderboards, badges, likes, and competitive metrics.

explore.title: Explore the public archive
explore.lead: Browse recent public records across donations, acts, and open work.

search.title: Search the archive
search.hint: Type a username, title, tag, or organization to search the public archive.

donate.title: Official Giving Platforms
donate.notice: Curvio does not collect donations. All links below lead to official organization websites.
donate.transparencyBody: We select platforms that demonstrate clear reporting and institutional trust. Always verify organizations independently before making a significant contribution. To suggest a donation address or report an issue, please open an Issue on our GitHub repository (link in the footer).

about.title: A quiet place for long-term goodwill
about.lead: Curvio is not a fundraising platform. It is a digital public-welfare journal for recording donations, acts, and open work.
about.principleThree: Long-term commitment first, short-term heat second.
about.boundaryBody: No private payment links, no donation amount leaderboards, no likes, no rankings, and no personal fundraising funnel.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Curvio only collects data required for account access, public records, and basic social relations, with a minimum-data approach.
privacy.purposeBody: We collect account identity, profile fields, record content, follow relations, and display preferences to provide sign-in, publishing, profile display, and filtering features. Curvio does not process fundraising payments, so payment-card or charge data is not collected.
privacy.scopeBody: Public pages display only information and records that you choose to make public. Amount visibility remains hidden by default and anonymous posting remains available. location, website_url, github_url, blog_url, bio, and principle are optional and never mandatory.
privacy.deleteBody: You can edit profile fields in settings and manage individual records from the dashboard. Account deletion is not available in this phase.
